headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Joins The NASDAQ Composite, Is The Stock Still Undervalued?

headlines.title: GM board evaluates CEO succession options with Sterling Anderson in focus - report
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- General Motors Company (NASDAQ:GM) has positioned global product chief Sterling Anderson as a leading contender to eventually succeed longtime Chief Executive Officer Mary Barra, signaling a strategic pivot toward software and autonomous driving expertise at the top of the automaker, according to Bloomberg.

headlines.title: Ford vs GM vs Stellantis: how the three Detroit automakers compare
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- The ranking is clear: General Motors (GM) leads on profitability, Ford Motor (F) leads on income, while Stellantis (STLA) offers the largest valuation gap—but with the weakest operating evidence.

headlines.title: Ford And GM Saved By US Government, Again
headlines.summary: Jim Farley says Chinese EVs would put Ford out of business, and Washington is building a wider moat to keep them away. But Detroit's real weakness lies far from American shores, and Europe already shows what could come.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
